name: BibleGet
author: John R. D'Orazio
description: Fetch Bible quotes from the BibleGet API.

BibleGetApiBase.description: Base URL of the BibleGet v4 API.

BibleGetApiKey.description: Optional site API key sent to the BibleGet API.

BibleGetClientKey.description: Bundled client key identifying this extension to the BibleGet API.

BibleGetDefaultBibleVersion.description: Bible version used when a quote does not name one.

BibleGetCacheExpiry.description: Seconds a fetched quote is cached.

BibleGetMaxQuotesPerPage.description: Maximum number of Bible quotes rendered on one page.

BibleGetMaxVersesPerQuote.description: Maximum number of verses rendered for one quote.
